descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limits

The single-user QPS limit for this API is 100 queries per second (QPS). API calls exceeding this limit will be throttled, which may affect your business. You can call this API at a reasonable rate. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).
